name: B08-OBJECTIVE-ABLATION

evaluation.metric: query target MSE and masked feature MSE
evaluation.mask: one of four features per query; support fully observed
evaluation.aggregation: pool equal-sized episodes; show per-seed points and sample SD
evaluation.baseline: support mean for target and each feature

deviations: Synthetic same-family tasks; no real-dataset generalization claim
Small two-block single-head model, LayerNorm, scalar heads and fixed mask pattern; not released LimiX architecture
No mixture-density decoder, mask-indicator prediction or published pretraining corpus
Combined loss is an unweighted sum; gradient magnitude may differ
Reconstruction-only leaves final target head untrained; poor target performance is not surprising
